Method of Attack: Exploitation of zero-day path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2023-47246) in SysAid to upload a WAR archive containing a webshell into the SysAid Tomcat webroot, enabling unauthorized code execution
Execution of PowerShell scripts to load GraceWire malware injected into legitimate processes (e.g., spoolsv.exe, msiexec.exe, svchost.exe)
Use of malware loader (user.exe) to check for Sophos security products and evade detection
Exfiltration of data followed by use of PowerShell scripts to delete activity logs and erase attack traces
Deployment of additional scripts to fetch Cobalt Strike listener on compromised hosts
Impacted Systems: corporate servers running SysAid Tomcat web service
Attack Vector: Zero-day vulnerability exploitation in SysAid service management software
Path traversal vulnerability allowing upload of malicious WAR archive
Webshell deployment and execution via SysAid Tomcat webroot
Indicators of Compromise: Unusual WAR, ZIP, or JSP files with anomalous timestamps in SysAid Tomcat webroot
Unauthorized WebShell files in SysAid Tomcat service
PowerShell script executions matching attack patterns
Malicious code injection into spoolsv.exe, msiexec.exe, svchost.exe
Connections to C2 IP addresses used by Lace Tempest (Fin11, TA505)
Deleted activity logs indicating attacker cleanup
